messages.author: aa67e6a57333adaf
messages.subject: R version issues
parts:
Hi everyone, I am trying to install FIELDimageR and it is throwing an error as:

> install.packages("FIELDimageR_0.2.9.tar.gz") # Make sure to use the right version (e.g. 0.2.9)
Warning in install.packages :
  package ‘FIELDimageR_0.2.9.tar.gz’ is not available (for R version 4.0.0)

Is the FIELDimageR available for R 4.0?

I am using Rstudio on Mac. Thanks for any feedback. 
Best, Ravi

messages.author: c59b667c61f258ae
messages.subject: Re: R version issues
parts:
Hi Ravi,

Could you try to use the following code, please?

install.packages("devtools") 
install.packages("sp") 
install.packages("raster") 
install.packages("rgdal") 
install.packages("maptools")
devtools::install_github("filipematias23/FIELDimageR")

Let me know if it workes.

Also, there are some different ways to install FIELDimageR here: https://github.com/OpenDroneMap/FIELDimageR#Instal

All the best,
Filipe
